decision_conditions:
<p>Within three months of
the date of this permission, details of the cycle parking provision shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
details shall include the number and type of cycle parking spaces, capacity,
layout, means of enclosure and security arrangements, including locking
facilities, demonstrating compliance with the relevant standards of Secured by
Design. The approved cycle parking shall be provided within three months of the
written approval of the details and thereafter retained, maintained and made
available for users of the premises</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The front curtilage shall be laid out in accordance with the approved plans, including the provision and location of the cycle and refuse storage facilities, two parking spaces (one of which shall be designated as an accessible parking bay) and associated planters. The approved arrangements shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The development hereby permitted shall be operated and maintained in
accordance with the fire safety measures and evacuation arrangements set out in
the approved Fire Statement and Plan (Ref. AF6337, Issue 01, dated 15/12/26).
All fire safety measures identified within the approved document shall be
implemented within three months of the date of this permission, insofar as they
have not already been implemented, and thereafter retained and maintained for
the lifetime of the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The community hall and meeting place hereby permitted shall only be open
to visitors between the hours of 08:00 and 22:00 Monday to Saturday, and 09:00
and 21:00 on Sundays and Bank Holidays. All activities shall cease and visitors
shall have vacated the premises by the specified closing times. Notices shall
be prominently displayed at the exits requesting that visitors leave quietly
and respect the amenity of neighbouring occupiers. These notices shall be
retained for the lifetime of the use<span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:
bold">.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out and the use
thereafter operated in accordance with the following approved plans and
documents, except where otherwise required by conditions attached to this
permission</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">-<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">Location

Statement &amp; Plan (Reference AF6337 Issue 01 dated 15 December 2025)&nbsp;<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">Within three months of the date of this permission, details demonstrating
accessible and inclusive access to and throughout the ground-floor premises
shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The details shall include confirmation of step-free access at the principal
entrance, internal circulation routes, any changes in floor levels and the
provision of accessible WC facilities, together with details of any works
necessary to ensure appropriate accessibility. Any works identified and
approved as necessary shall be completed within six months of the written
approval of the details and thereafter retained for the lifetime of the
development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">Within three months of the date of this permission, details of the refuse
and recycling storage facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing
by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the capacity, number
and type of containers, location, layout, means of enclosure, access
arrangements and measures to ensure the facilities are secure and appropriately
screened. The approved facilities shall be provided within three months of the
written approval of the details and thereafter retained, maintained and made
available for use.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
